source_tables: csi_new_shipper_to_invoice (booking_id, shipper_id) -- 11,654 rows, one per booking, 2022-2026
_provenance.bill_to_note: No override row means the booking is billed to the shipping funeral home itself. This is the rule the invoicing code in backend/quickbooks_service.py applies.
_provenance.cross_check: csi_invoiced_bookings.qb_customer_id agrees on 653 of 654 partner invoices in 2026
_provenance.unresolvable: 88 bookings are billed to 19 since-deleted funeral home records and cannot be attributed
_provenance.status: MEASURED aggregates only. The per-home manifest has not been delivered; figures derived from these aggregates alone are labelled [ESTIMATE] in reports.

new_accounts_window._definition: Homes whose first-ever booking fell on or after 2025-11-17.
new_accounts_window._by_partner_note: Overlapping: 38 homes used more than one partner across the full history.
new_accounts_window._unreconciled: 121 purely-partner + 4 also-billed-directly = 125 against 129 partner-billed: 4 homes sit in neither subset. Cause not stated in the relayed aggregates; most likely the 19 since-deleted homes carrying 88 unattributable bookings. 4 homes on 418 is 1.0% and moves no corrected figure. Asserted in tests/test_partner_routing.py::test_new_account_subsets_carry_a_known_four_home_gap.

all_partner_billed_2022_2026._overlap_note: 266 + 257 + 52 = 575 home-slots against 535 distinct homes = 40 of overlap. With 38 multi-partner homes this implies 36 two-partner and 2 three-partner homes.

by_year_homes_bookings._note: Calendar years. Home counts are per-partner and overlap across partners.

partner_own_record_bookings._note: Bookings recorded under the partner's own funeral_home_id as shipper, in data/raw/shipments-since-2022-20261110.xlsx.
